name: Amrita Bihani
role: Assistant Professor & Assistant Director, Family Business and Entrepreneurship Programme
bio: Dr. Amrita Bihani has been working as a Faculty since 2010 at Amrut Mody School of Management, Ahmedabad University. Her research interests include areas of Talent management, Employee Engagement, and Change Management. Her Ph.D. from CEPT University widened her research horizon. She had completed her minor thesis titled ‘A Study of Acceptance of Social Media as a Tool towards Recruitment’ and later completed her major thesis titled as 'A Study of Talent Management Practices in the Pharmaceutical Sector in India' in April, 2018 from CEPT University. She already has 1 national and couple of international publications to her research background.

Her career which spans over 16 years now, has a mix of both corporate exposure as well as academics. Soon after her PGDBM, she started working with ICICI Bank and later on moved on to TATA-AIG General Insurance Co. Ltd. and then to HDFC Bank. Having had six years of corporate association in the Financial Sector where she started as a Relationship Officer to Home Loan clients and in the due course of six years progressed to that of the Team Manager where she led a team of young managers, handling customer investment portfolios, private equity investments and other financial products. She has also been associated with a management school at Chennai, affiliated to University of Madras for a very short stint in the year 2019-20.

With a keen interest in academics, she started teaching Strategic Human Resources Management at a private University in Ahmedabad, alongwith her corporate role at HDFC Bank. This triggered further interest in the field of academics, and she thus plunged into the opportunity of becoming a lecturer the newly constituted Ahmedabad University in the year 2010. Her Alma mater B. K. Majumdar Institute of Business Administration, also known as HLBBA at that point in time, was where she started her academic career. She started teaching courses like Identity and Behavior, Organizational Processes, Organization Behavior, Human Resources Management, Strategic HRM, International HRM, Organization Development, Social Change Management and Human Resource Development.

Her key strength has been her capacity to bring in practical examples from her own corporate experience to the class, communication skills and an effective team member at the workplace. At present she ably is shouldering the responsibility of chairing the iMBA (Integrated MBA) Programme at the University. Her corporate exposure also makes a good team member, an efficient manager and a good administrator.

sections.title: Professional Service
paragraphs: 1. Worked with HDFC Bank Ltd as an Investment Banker – Private Banking & Equities Group from July 2009 to Jan. 2010.
Handled a clientele of HNIs with a net worth of 50 lakhs and above for the Bank
Responsible for managing current portfolios, churning them as well as have proper asset allocation done at the requisite time intervals; keeping in mind the client requirements

To generate revenues for the Bank through Advisory Services as well as sales of Investment Products which would comprise of Mutual Funds, Life & General Insurance, Trading Platform, Private Equities and PMS
2. Worked with ING Vysya Bank as a Relationship Manager - Wealth Management from Sept. 2008 to July 2009.
Responsible for generating revenue for the Bank through sales of Mutual Fund and Life Insurance
Coordinating with different AMCs for an update on the various products available in the market so as to update ourselves on the market trends
Managing the portfolio of HNI customers already associated with the Bank.
3. Worked with TATA-AIG General Insurance Company as a Retention Manager from Feb 2006 to September 2008.
Managing Retention portfolio for Products in Auto, Accident & Health and Home insurance
Managing a team of young executives to control business sourcing while also monitoring their performance on a day-to-day basis
Training sales executives on a regular basis on product knowledge, sales skills, and convincing skills.
4. Worked with ICICI Home Finance Company as a Relationship Officer April 2004 to Feb 2006.
Handling a team of sales executives and monitoring them and their performance on a daily basis
Coordinating with the Credit Manager for timely completion of files in order to maintain the set Turnaround Time by the company
Coordinating with the outsourced agencies for completion of the required processes, again to maintain the turnaround time
